subject.title: [Feature]: Buscador/filtro en dropdown de modelos del Control UI

question: Should the Control UI standardize a reusable searchable model picker now, and should the first version include provider faceting or text search only?
rationale: The issue identifies a real usability need, but the component scope and provider-filter semantics affect more than one picker and must align with the Gateway’s existing catalog views.

options.title: Ship text search first
options.body: Add a reusable accessible text filter over the already returned picker catalog, while deferring provider facets until their semantics are specified.

options.title: Include provider facets
options.body: Define and implement provider grouping/filtering together with text search, including behavior for configured, dynamic, and full-catalog views.

options.title: Limit catalog only
options.body: Rely on configured catalog filtering and decline picker search, accepting that large configured model sets remain list-only.

recommendation.title: Ship text search first
recommendation.body: Add a reusable accessible text filter over the already returned picker catalog, while deferring provider facets until their semantics are specified.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Control UI picker and chat interaction work is the closest available ownership signal.
